==Ingredients==

* 3 [[Cookbook:Garlic|cloves garlic]], [[Cookbook:Mincing|minced]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] minced [[Cookbook:Ginger|fresh ginger root]]
* 1–2 [[Cookbook:Chile|fresh hot chiles]], minced (or ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Red Pepper|hot red pepper flakes]])
* 4 [[Cookbook:Scallion|scallions]], separated: white part minced, green part cut on the diagonal in ½-inch pieces
* 3 tablespoons [[Cookbook:Douchi|Chinese black beans]]
* ¼ to ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] [[Cookbook:Stock|stock]]
* 2 tablespoons [[Cookbook:Soy Sauce|soy sauce]]
* 2 teaspoons [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* ½ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Sesame Oil|sesame oil]]
* 1 teaspoon [[Cookbook:Cornstarch|cornstarch]]
* 1 tablespoon [[Cookbook:Wine|rice wine]] or [[Cookbook:Wine|sherry]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]] (900 g) [[Cookbook:Shellfish|shellfish]] ([[Cookbook:Clam|clams]], [[Cookbook:Mussel|mussels]], [[Cookbook:Crab|crabs]], and/or [[Cookbook:Lobster|lobster]]) or 1 pound (450 g) of [[Cookbook:shrimp|shrimp]], [[Cookbook:Fish|fish]], [[Cookbook:Poultry|poultry]], or [[Cookbook:Pork|pork]]
* 1½ tablespoons [[Cookbook:Canola Oil|canola oil]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Onion|onion cubes]]
* 1 red [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell pepper]] or ½ red and ½ [[Cookbook:Green Pepper|green peppers]], cut in cubes
* 2–3 cups, thinly sliced [[Cookbook:Vegetable|vegetables]] ([[Cookbook:Cabbage|cabbage]], [[Cookbook:Snow Pea|snow peas]], and/or [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]]
* [[Cookbook:Steaming|Steamed]] [[Cookbook:Rice|white rice]], optional

==Procedure==
# In small bowl, combine garlic, ginger root, chilies, scallion whites, and black beans.
# In another small bowl, combine ¼ cup stock, soy sauce, sugar, and sesame oil, and stir until sugar dissolves.
# In a third small bowl, dissolve cornstarch in wine or sherry.
# Scrub clams, if using, cut shellfish into 1-inch pieces or thinly slice poultry or meat.
# Just before serving, heat a [[Cookbook:Wok|wok]] over high heat.
# Swirl in canola oil.
# [[Cookbook:Stir-frying|Stir-Fry]] onion and bell pepper for a minute then add garlic and bean mixture and cook for 15 seconds, or until fragrant but not brown.
# Add seafood and stir-fry for 1 minute.
# Add stock-based sauce and cook for 2 to 5 minutes, or until seafood is cooked; if necessary to prevent mixture from sticking to pan, add remaining stock. (If steaming clams, tightly cover wok.)
# Stir cornstarch mixture and add to stir-fry along with scallion greens and sliced vegetables.
# Bring sauce to a [[Cookbook:Boil|boil]].
# Serve immediately along with white rice if desired.
